items.title: fix(agents): treat native hook relay records with a dead pid as absen…
items.summary: fix(agents): treat native hook relay records with a dead pid as absent (#128112) * fix(agents): treat native hook relay records with a dead pid as absent readNativeHookRelayClientBridgeRecord's expiry check never consulted the recorded pid, so a bridge whose owning process died kept resolving as a live locator for its full TTL. Lookups then spent their deadline retrying a connection to an unreachable loopback port instead of falling back. Extract the ESRCH liveness check already used by registration-time pruning into a shared helper and consult it in the cold client lookup path before attempting a connection. * refactor(agents): reuse PID liveness helper --------- Co-authored-by: Bek
